faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR NEERI Project Associate (PAT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate (PAT) positions is 28th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate (PAT) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Associate (PAT) position in the CSIR NEERI Recruitment 2026 drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Project Associate (PAT) role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B. Tech degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering from a recognized university to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate (PAT) position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate (PAT) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 31,000/- plus HRA, depending on their qualifications and NET/GATE status.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSIR NEERI Project Associate (PAT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate (PAT) posts will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The positions are contractual in nature, meaning they are offered on a fixed-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR NEERI is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 440020.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Maharashtra apply?
faq.answer: The notification mentions applications are invited from eligible candidates in Maharashtra. However, for definitive eligibility regarding domicile, please refer to the official notification PDF.
